To avoid rudeness, I noticed that they didn't even respond to a "good afternoon" greeting. Note, it's understandable if they were performing a task, but yesterday I commented to the person who accompanied me that silence is normal as a response to a greeting. Right after, a couple of customers came in and said "good afternoon," and the response was silence.
The worst came after I paid. I noticed that I had items with a different price than what was on the shelves.
I normally asked for verification, and when I tried to naturally explain where I had taken one of the items, the employee said, "Calm down." This statement led me to question why she told me to calm down if the conversation was perfectly normal between customer and employee.
Next, there was an unreasonable delay in getting the overpaid money back.
In conclusion, I found a lack of suitable profiles for the job...

Tienda Animal in Campo Grande is, without a doubt, one of the best pet stores I've ever visited! The service is exceptional; the team is always very attentive, helpful, and ready to assist with any questions or needs.

The variety of products is incredible: quality pet food, accessories, toys, hygiene items, and everything is always very well organized. You can see the care and affection the store has for the well-being of pets.

The location is also a major plus: easy to find, in a pleasant and always well-maintained environment.

I recommend Tienda Animal to anyone seeking quality, trust, and excellent service!

I couldn't be happier with this store. The variety of products is incredible — from healthy food and snacks to toys, accessories, and hygiene items — all of excellent quality. You can tell that each product is carefully chosen, truly thinking about the well-being of our furry friends.

The service is wonderful: professional, attentive, and super available to help choose the best for each animal. It's a pleasure to be served by someone who truly understands the subject and demonstrates passion for what they do.

The prices are very fair, and I found several options that I didn't see in other stores. The store is organized, pleasant, and inspires confidence from the first moment.

I always take my pet with me, and he is received with affection — which makes all the difference!

I recommend it without hesitation! A store like this deserves recognition: quality, friendliness, and dedication all in one place. 🐾💛

I've been to that store a few times, and the service has always been friendly and pleasant, with a great variety of pet supplies. However, yesterday when I arrived with my husband, there wasn't a single employee present. We went in, chose what we needed, and then, as we were going to the checkout to pay, a young woman with glasses walked past us. She didn't even look at us or say anything. We thought she was a customer, so we went to the checkout, and suddenly she appeared. She didn't greet us, didn't even look at us, kept her head down the whole time, and was extremely hostile. It seemed like she was doing us a favor by serving us. I'm not the type of customer who complains, but yesterday's treatment was simply awful!!
